issues.detail: Instructions do not cover all potential error scenarios or edge cases.
The skill file contains extensive narrative that may be considered padded.
Skill relies on agent-specific plugin commands, limiting universal applicability.

scenarios.name: install-and-verify-superpowers
scenarios.rationale: Response A covers most rubric items but omits the design document requirement, while Response B provides no content.

scenarios.name: diagnose-superpowers-misbehaviour
scenarios.rationale: Response B includes the invocation of the diagnosing-superpowers skill but omits session ID syntax and the bug‑report bundle detail, whereas Response A provides no relevant information.

scenarios.name: opt-out-superpowers-telemetry
scenarios.rationale: Response B correctly specifies the required environment variable and notes telemetry disabling, while Response A omits the required variable and fails to mention the optional visual companion.
